fuel_get_prices.name: fuel_get_prices
fuel_get_prices.title: Fuel prices of Georgian fuel companies
fuel_get_prices.description: Returns the current fuel prices of Georgian fuel companies: the price in GEL of one unit of each product. Use it for the price of petrol, diesel, or gas at a company today, or to compare companies. Each product has a grade that every company shares: regular (litre), premium (litre), super (litre), super_100 (litre), diesel (litre), cng (cubic_metre), lpg (litre), other (litre). price: the price in GEL of one unit at a station with an attendant. self_service_price: the price in GEL of one unit at a self-service station of the same company. A product with no self_service_price has none. The fuel companies of this server: connect (Connect, publishes no effective date), gulf (Gulf), lukoil (Lukoil), neogas (Neogas, publishes no effective date), portal (Portal, publishes no effective date), rompetrol (Rompetrol, publishes no effective date), socar (SOCAR, publishes no effective date), wissol (Wissol). The prices are of today. The tool has no history.

grades.description: Grades: regular, premium, super, super_100, diesel, cng, lpg, other. Empty asks every grade.

companies.description: Fuel company codes. Empty asks every company. The description of the tool lists the codes.

language.description: The language of the product names: ka or en. The default is en.

meaning.description: How to read price and self_service_price.

source.description: The name of the fuel company.

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the prices, RFC 3339. The company publishes no instant.

stale.description: True when the company did not answer and the server returns prices it read before.

product.description: The name of the product at the company.

grade.description: The grade of the product, the same for every company.

unit.description: The unit of each price: litre, or cubic_metre for cng.

price.description: The standard price in GEL of one unit, as a decimal string.

self_service_price.description: The price in GEL of one unit at a self-service station of the company, as a decimal string. Absent when the company publishes none.

effective_date.description: The date from which the company applies the prices, YYYY-MM-DD. Absent when the company publishes no date: as_of then gives the age of the price.

prices.description: The prices of the products, sorted by grade.

missing.description: The requested grades that the company does not sell.

companies.description: The prices of each fuel company that answered, sorted by company code.

source.description: The name of the fuel company.

unavailable.description: The fuel companies that did not answer.

benefit.description: The text of the bank that states the benefit. Read the percent, the cap, and the conditions from it.

kinds.description: The benefit kinds that the bank states in a field. other: the bank states none.

categories.description: The offer categories, the same for every bank.

bank_categories.description: The names of the categories at the bank.

tiers.description: The customer tiers that can use the offer.

name.description: The name of the card at the bank.

cards.description: The cards that the offer names. Absent: every card of the tiers.

start_date.description: The first date of the offer, YYYY-MM-DD. Absent when the bank publishes none.

end_date.description: The last date of the offer, YYYY-MM-DD. Absent when the bank publishes none.

url.description: The page of the offer at the bank. Give it to the person with each offer that you name.

terms.description: The full conditions of the offer, as the bank writes them.

offers_search_offers.name: offers_search_offers
offers_search_offers.title: Card offers of Georgian banks
offers_search_offers.description: Finds the current offers that Georgian banks give to card holders at partners: discounts, cashback, and points. Filters by bank, customer tier, category, benefit kind, card, and period. For "this month", give the first and the last date of the month. When a bank has a next_offset, call again with that offset to read more. The benefit is the text of the bank. Compare the banks by reading it. Give the person the url of each offer that you name. benefit is the text of the bank. The server reads no number from it: read the percent, the cap, and the conditions from the text. kinds come from a field of the bank, and other means that the bank states none. tiers: standard is every customer, premium the premium package (SOLO at BOG), private the private banking (Wealth Management at BOG), youth the pupils and the students. The banks of this server: bog (Bank of Georgia), liberty (Liberty Bank), tbc (TBC Bank). The card codes of each bank: bog: amex (Amex), mastercard (Mastercard), mastercard_world_elite (Mastercard World Elite), plus (PLUS), scool_card (sCool Card), solo (SOLO), student_card (Student Card), super_plus (Super PLUS), teacher_card (Teacher Card), visa (Visa), visa_infinite (Visa Infinite), visa_platinum (Visa Platinum), visa_signature (Visa Signature); liberty: mastercard (Mastercard), top_card_black (Top|Card Black Edition), visa (Visa); tbc: concept_card (TBC Concept Card), credit_card (Credit Card), crypto (Crypto), installment (Installment), mastercard (Mastercard), pay_later (Pay Later), pupil_card (Pupil's Card), tbc_card (TBC Card), travel_card (Travel Card), visa (Visa).

banks.description: Bank codes. Empty asks every bank. The description lists the codes.

tiers.description: Customer tiers: standard, premium, private, youth. An offer matches when it has one of them.

categories.description: Offer categories: dining, leisure, travel, health_beauty, auto, transport, shopping, electronics, home, education, kids, entertainment, real_estate, other.

kinds.description: Benefit kinds: discount, cashback, points, other.

cards.description: Card codes of the banks. An offer that names no card matches every card. The description lists the codes of each bank.

to.description: The last date of the period, YYYY-MM-DD, at most 366 days after from. The default is from.

language.description: The language of the texts: ka or en. The default is en.

limit.description: The maximum count of offers for each bank, 1 to 30. The default is 10.

offset.description: The count of matching offers of each bank to skip, 0 or more. Give the next_offset of a bank to read its next page. The default is 0.

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the offers, RFC 3339. The bank publishes no instant.

stale.description: True when the bank did not answer and the server returns offers it read before.

total.description: The count of every matching offer of the bank. offers holds at most limit of them.

next_offset.description: The offset of the next page of the bank. Absent when offers holds the last matching offer.

id.description: The offer id of the bank. offers_get_offer takes it.

partner.description: The company that gives the benefit. Absent when the bank names none.

benefit.description: The text of the bank that states the benefit. Read the percent, the cap, and the conditions from it.

kinds.description: The benefit kinds that the bank states in a field. other: the bank states none.

categories.description: The offer categories, the same for every bank.

bank_categories.description: The names of the categories at the bank.

tiers.description: The customer tiers that can use the offer.

code.description: The card code. cards of offers_search_offers takes it.

name.description: The name of the card at the bank.

cards.description: The cards that the offer names. Absent: every card of the tiers.

start_date.description: The first date of the offer, YYYY-MM-DD. Absent when the bank publishes none.

end_date.description: The last date of the offer, YYYY-MM-DD. Absent when the bank publishes none.

url.description: The page of the offer at the bank. Give it to the person with each offer that you name.

offers.description: The matching offers, the soonest end first.

banks.description: The offers of each bank that answered, sorted by bank code.

rates_get_commercial_rates.name: rates_get_commercial_rates
rates_get_commercial_rates.title: Commercial exchange rates of Georgian banks
rates_get_commercial_rates.description: Returns the current commercial exchange rates of Georgian banks: the prices in GEL at which a bank buys and sells one unit of a currency. Use it for the price of a currency at a bank today, or to compare banks. Ask for 1 to 10 currencies. buy: the price in GEL that the bank pays when you sell it one unit. sell: the price in GEL that the bank asks when you buy one unit from it. The banks of this server: bog (Bank of Georgia), kursi (Kursi.ge, an online exchange bureau), liberty (Liberty Bank), rico (Rico Credit, a microfinance organization), tbc (TBC Bank), terabank (Terabank). The list gives the kind of each one that is not a bank. The rates are of today. The tool has no history.

currencies.description: 1 to 10 ISO 4217 codes, for example USD and EUR.

banks.description: Bank codes. Empty asks every bank. The description of the tool lists the codes.

meaning.description: How to read buy and sell.

as_of.description: The oldest instant at which the server read a rate of this bank, RFC 3339. The bank publishes no instant.

stale.description: True when the bank did not answer and the server returns rates it read before.

buy.description: The price in GEL that the bank pays for one unit, as a decimal string.

sell.description: The price in GEL that the bank asks for one unit, as a decimal string.

rates.description: The commercial rates, sorted by currency.

missing.description: The requested codes that the bank does not quote.

banks.description: The rates of each bank that answered, sorted by bank code.

unavailable.description: The banks that did not answer.

rates_get_official_rates.name: rates_get_official_rates
rates_get_official_rates.title: Official exchange rates of the NBG
rates_get_official_rates.description: Returns the official exchange rates of the lari that the National Bank of Georgia (NBG) sets, for one date. Use it for the rate of a currency today or on a past date, for a contract, an invoice, or a tax form. Each rate is the price in GEL of `quantity` units; `rate_per_unit` is the price of one unit. The NBG publishes the rates of each business day at about 17:00 Tbilisi time, in force from the next day until the next set. A weekend or a holiday returns the set in force on it. The official rate is indicative. It is not the price of a bank.

currencies.description: ISO 4217 codes, for example USD and EUR. Empty returns every currency. At most 50.

date.description: The date in YYYY-MM-DD, in Tbilisi. Empty means today. At most the valid date of the newest set: tomorrow after about 17:00.

language.description: The language of the currency names: en or ka. Empty means en.

as_of.description: The publication instant of the set, RFC 3339. The read instant when the set is empty.

valid_from.description: The date from which the set is in force, YYYY-MM-DD.

read_at.description: The instant the server read the set from the NBG, RFC 3339.

stale.description: True when the NBG did not answer and the server returns a set it read before.

name.description: The name of the currency in the requested language.

quantity.description: The count of units that rate prices.

rate.description: The price in GEL of quantity units, as a decimal string.

rate_per_unit.description: The price in GEL of one unit, as a decimal string.

change.description: The change of rate from the previous set, signed, as a decimal string.

valid_from.description: The date from which this rate is in force, YYYY-MM-DD.

rates.description: The official rates, sorted by currency.

missing.description: The requested codes with no official rate on the date.

rates_list_official_history.name: rates_list_official_history
rates_list_official_history.title: Official exchange rate history of the NBG
rates_list_official_history.description: Returns the official exchange rates of one currency over a period of up to 31 days, as set by the National Bank of Georgia (NBG). Use it for the movement of a currency over a week or a month. The answer holds one point for each set in force in the period, the set in force on the first day included. Each rate is the price in GEL of `quantity` units.

currency.description: One ISO 4217 code, for example USD.

from.description: The first date of the period, YYYY-MM-DD.

to.description: The last date of the period, YYYY-MM-DD. At most 31 days after from, counted with both ends.

language.description: The language of the currency name: en or ka. Empty means en.

as_of.description: The publication instant of the newest point, RFC 3339.

read_at.description: The oldest instant at which the server read a point from the NBG, RFC 3339.

stale.description: True when one point comes from a set read before an outage of the NBG.

name.description: The name of the currency in the requested language.
The name of the currency in the requested language.

quantity.description: The count of units that rate prices.

rate.description: The price in GEL of quantity units, as a decimal string.

rate_per_unit.description: The price in GEL of one unit, as a decimal string.

change.description: The change of rate from the previous set, signed, as a decimal string.

valid_from.description: The date from which this rate is in force, YYYY-MM-DD.

points.description: One official rate for each set in force in the period, ascending by valid_from.

transit_get_route.name: transit_get_route

source.description: The source of the data: TTC.

language.description: The language of the names: ka or en. The default is en.

source.description: The source of the data: TTC.

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the timetable, RFC 3339.

number.description: The route number that the vehicle shows.

name.description: The name of the route, usually its two ends.

code.description: The number on the sign of a bus stop. Absent for a station of metro or cable car.

transit_list_arrivals.title: Next arrivals at a stop in Tbilisi
